new_libraries.name: ReflectINI
new_libraries.author: Michael michi.fu@quickline.ch
new_libraries.sentence: INI writer and reader for microcontrollers with struct reflection (REFLECT/MEMBER), sections, arrays and precise error locations.
new_libraries.paragraph: Write and read C++ structs as INI files without hand-written parsing code. Nested structs become [sections], arrays become lists, std::optional and const char* are nullable. Parses from const char* (optional zero-copy), no heap use while reading or writing, error path / line / column. Shares ReflectCore.h with ReflectJSON (same struct for JSON and INI), but does not require it. Needs C++17 (RP2040/RP2350, ESP32, Teensy 4.x, Arduino UNO R4). Free for noncommercial use; commercial use requires a license.

library.name: FansElectronics_DMD32
library.author: Fans Electronics, Irfan Indra Kurniawan, S.T
library.sentence: DMD32 Library for ESP32 HUB12 & HUB08 Support P10, P4.25, & P7.62.
library.paragraph: DMD32 Library for ESP32 HUB12 & HUB08 Support P10, P4.25, & P7.62. This library is designed to control DMD (Dot Matrix Display) panels using ESP32 microcontrollers. It provides functions to initialize the display, set pixel colors, and update the display with new data.
